notes.source: standup chat (Igor's notes-to-self summary of the standup, not a raw transcript)
notes.text: Calvin Cochran: Rubrik doing fine, still needs confirmation that the log deletion issue is resolved. Initial standalone backup took about 16 hours; Calvin raised risk of a 16h run overlapping production backup. Mike Massimino and Karl Witt: low tolerance for production risk, so do not accelerate during the weekday. Plan: kick off Friday night, a few days of dual running next week, then ship readiness. Karl: Manchester space should be ready before equipment arrives.

Igor posted progress: 4 successful Pure backups so far (2-3 more ideal). Next major step is activating Rubrik on the RAC instance Friday 10/16 (about 16 hours). Timeline: 10/16 IOSP-1014 (Calvin), 10/16 18:00 UTC IOSP-1012 (Earle), 10/17-10/20 IOSP-880, 10/20 to TBD IOSP-1013 (Sri, Calvin), 10/27-11/9 IOSP-1015 shipment. Earle agreed to start Friday 16th. Rubrik RAC job to run 18:00 UTC daily; Oracle job runs on scdpcarac1 at 06:00 UTC.
Karl Witt: a company is being contracted to pack and ship the gear and will provide anything that needs signing (Tech X, resold via MicroAge per transcript).
IOSP-1011 (Pure backup, Earle) and IOSP-1014 (confirm Pure backup, Calvin) considered complete: ran several days with no issues. RAC enablement was planned Friday 18:00 UTC.

Discovered scdpcarac1/2 have no interface on CA Backup VLAN 130 (Rubrik only configured for VLANs 130 and 2988); Prajeet's IPs are RAC-internal/VIP only. Agreement that Rubrik must only sit on backup VLANs, so VLAN 130 addressing is needed on the RAC hosts via an RM (Prajeet: RM is better). Work on production RAC1 can only be done in a maintenance window (starts 7pm Eastern / midnight UK); this pushes the initial 16h Rubrik RAC backup from Friday to Sunday. Earle suggested starting it Sunday 10/18 13:00 UTC (16h window ends about 05:00 UTC Monday). Prajeet agreed Rubrik and the local RMAN backup may overlap (weekend), accepting small overlap Monday morning. No VM restart needed to add interface (Calvin).

Open design question: RAC is one database with two instances; best practice is to connect via SCAN name not IPs. Rubrik cannot reach the SCAN/VIP because they are not on VLAN 130/2988. Calvin: this crosses the boundary into the CA environment. Actions: Sri to contact Rubrik Support, Prajeet to open an Oracle Support ticket (expected response within 24h).

Shipment: Calvin said the long pole is contract signature by procurement (Karl pinged this morning); will not move date up without a signed contract. Appliance prep (give each of about 12 nodes a new IP and shut down) takes a couple of hours, target 10/21. Tech X does the physical work; two Sectigo people needed in the cage (Olu plus a second via Jamie). Earle: DBA background work (IOSP-1009) may start earlier than November, end of next week (10/23) at the latest; standby now running in Manchester and catching up. Sri set up a meeting next week with Net Ops for Manchester connectivity prep. Calvin: replication to Manchester must be verified as part of IOSP-880. Gabriel Rovira: no update on the AD/EDB project.

Status ON-TRACK (sent by Igor 2026-10-14). Completed: IOSP-1011 (Earle), IOSP-1014 (Calvin). Pending: shipment updates from Karl and procurement; waiting on Oracle (Prajeet) after which Calvin creates RM for maintenance window; meeting next week with Network team. Timeline: IOSP-1012 10/16 18:00 UTC (Sri); IOSP-880 10/17-10/20; IOSP-1013 10/21 (Sri, Calvin); IOSP-1010 10/21-TBD (Karl/Calvin, procurement); IOSP-1015 10/27-11/9 shipment; IOSP-1009 10/23-11/23 (Earle); IOSP-1004/1005 11/9-11/16 (Manchester infra, Priya/Mena); IOSP-1006 11/16-12/6 (Calvin, Sri); IOSP-1007 11/30-12/6 production testing Manchester; IOSP-1008 12/7 fully production in Europe.

Igor reviewed the old Confluence Rubrik project goals with Calvin/SriChand and added objectives to epic IOSP-471. Calvin: change the objective on decommissioning legacy backup mechanisms to 'Evaluate decommission of legacy backup mechanisms'. Calvin added Rubrik-as-source monthly restore validation; Earle clarified the step is a SASP recover (not backup) onto bdddcanlora[3 or 5].

Calvin summarised VLAN options for RAC; option 2 supported by Rubrik. Filed RM-1658 (configure CA Backup VLAN on RAC hosts) and requested approvals; separate RM-1660 (MCR hosts) approval requested 10/15; Calvin also looking for RM-1658/1660/1661.

Prajeet: backup IPs do not need to be registered with Oracle Clusterware; Rubrik can make both RAC nodes eligible for backup (ordered node list). Calvin (in the CA/change channel): if the VLAN change is not completed in the maintenance window it pushes back Rubrik timelines; Martijn Katerbarg approved the change. Prajeet agreed to do the standalone Oracle work during a SASP maintenance window.

Earle will ask Ramana whether CA backup interfaces are up and post in the Rubrik chat so Sri can add hosts in Rubrik; backup will not start until maintenance window completes. Calvin has another commitment and will watch for Sri's updates.

Prajeet: Oracle part is done; pending items are backup VLAN and Rubrik validation. Prajeet also doubts Rubrik should need the DB user password, since that defeats the Oracle Credentials Wallet (wallet-based auth for Rubrik backup on SASP production RAC).

risks: Schedule slip: RAC interfaces lacked CA Backup VLAN 130; the change must land in the weekend maintenance window (Calvin: failing that pushes back Rubrik timelines); initial 16h backup moved from Fri 10/16 to about Sun 10/18, so IOSP-880 and 10/21 prep may slip.
Initial 16h Rubrik backup overlaps the production RMAN backup on RAC1 (production load risk; mgmt has low tolerance for production risk).
Rubrik cannot reach RAC SCAN/VIP over backup VLANs; design relies on IPs or a new backup VIP, crossing into the CA environment (Oracle and Rubrik support responses pending).
Authentication: Prajeet states Rubrik should not need the DB user password (Oracle Credentials Wallet); needs resolution before production RAC validation.
Shipment contract not yet signed by procurement; Calvin will not move the date forward without it; Oct 27-Nov 9 shipment and Dec 7 go-live depend on it.
Manchester readiness (space, network prep) must be confirmed before appliances arrive; Net Ops meeting pending.
Production RAC changes only in maintenance windows; dependency on SRE availability (Ramana, tier 2).
